answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks with Cuckoo Cycle memory-hard proofs at the dawn of each epoch. Each agent hashes its key with the cedar block digest to seed a large bipartite graph and finds a 42-cycle that peers verify in microseconds. Because edge trimming saturates memory bandwidth, attackers cannot grow a vine of virtual identities and must fund gigabytes of fast DRAM per node. However, adversaries using hijacked servers can still subsidize that RAM cost.
